articles.title: Trump's 'drug boat' strikes may be crimes against humanity, UN says
articles.summary: The Trump administration's strikes on alleged "narco-trafficking" vessels amount to extrajudicial murders that violate international, maritime and humanitarian law, a United Nations report says.
